definition.text: A supply chain is the system of facilities that turn raw materials into finished products and distribute them to end customers.

facts.text: Suppliers sit in tiers: first-tier suppliers serve the client directly, second-tier suppliers serve the first tier, and so on.

Resilience of a supply chain has been read as persistence (engineering resilience), then as adaptation and transformation (ecological and social-ecological resilience), treating the chain as a social-ecological system.
After the 2013 Savar building collapse, auditing had to reach past first-tier suppliers, with better visibility and local partnerships.
The EU's draft supply chain law sets due diligence requirements to protect human rights and the environment along the chain.
